principle: A showroom is a curated Product Twin scene graph plus a guided narrative. It is not a separate fake catalogue.

experience_modes.description: Curated IKEA-like path through a sequence of scenes with deliberate reveals and design lessons.
Move freely through the house/showroom and inspect any Product Twin.
Show real products, materials, offers, substitutes and scene/project budget.
Keep the vibe while reducing cost, lead time or sourcing distance.
Transfer vibe DNA, selected Twins and design relationships into the user's own geometry and rerun fit/compliance/logistics.

learning_rule: Behavior updates style and procurement preferences, but never overrides technical/regulatory project constraints.
